rows.headline: GP Petroleums Board approves Rs. 44.27 Cr minority investment with Management Control of Incubit Pipavav Terminal Private Limited.
rows.subject: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
rows.title: GP Petroleums Board approves Rs. 44.27 Cr minority investment with Management Control of Incubit Pipavav Terminal Private Limited.
Press Release
rows.summary: GP Petroleums Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 13, 2026, titled "GP Petroleums  Board approves ₹44.27 Crores minority Investment with Management Control in Incubit Pipavav Terminal Private Limited ". The proposed transaction marks entry into logistics infrastructure, strengthening supply-chain resilience and creating a platform for growth.
